is_drop_shipment.description: Whether the sales order is a drop shipment.

is_backorder.description: Whether the sales order is a backorder.

is_manually_fulfilled.description: Whether the order is fulfilled manually rather than through inventory.

has_attachment.description: Whether the sales order has one or more attachments.

is_viewed_in_mail.description: Whether the emailed order has been viewed by the recipient.

mail_first_viewed_time.description: Timestamp of the first time the emailed order was viewed by the recipient, when known.

mail_last_viewed_time.description: Timestamp of the most recent time the emailed order was viewed by the recipient, when known.

is_scheduled_for_quick_shipment_create.description: Whether the order is scheduled for quick shipment creation.

created_time.description: Creation timestamp in Zoho offset format, e.g. 2026-10-09T14:28:36-0400. Example: 2026-10-09T14:28:36-0400

last_modified_time.description: Last modification timestamp in Zoho offset format, e.g. 2026-10-09T14:28:36-0400. Example: 2026-10-09T14:28:36-0400

tags.description: Tags attached to the sales order in the Zoho UI; each entry is the provider tag shape.

SalesOrder.description: A Zoho Inventory sales order as returned by the list sales orders endpoint.

SyncMetadata_zoho_inventory_salesorders.description: Optional connection metadata selecting the Zoho Inventory organization to sync.
